    Cocycles on the universal cover are coboundaries #

    Let c be an integer cocycle on the quiver of the universal cover Cover x₀. Walks of P act on pairs (u, n) (a walk class from x₀ and an integer) by lifting each arrow at the object ⟨_, u⟩ of the cover and adding its weight (liftF). Paths with the same nonzero value lift to paths of the cover with the same nonzero value, so the action factors through the fundamental groupoid (coverAct). The second component of the action of a.u on (𝟙, 0) is a potential for c (isCoboundary_cover): the cover is simply connected in the cohomological sense.
